desktop-1280x720.scene: Parcel Truck driving River Bridges, rendered native scene with UI
desktop-1280x720.scope: Desktop Linux software renderer under virtual X11; excludes installation/import; not mobile performance certification
desktop-1280x720.child_max_rss_note: Linux child process maximum RSS; display server still running at sample time
desktop-1280x720.fixture_note: Fresh isolated user-data directory. Later captures seed all course unlocks and custom layout; real game logic/rendering/input remains active. No production save is modified.
desktop-1280x720.timing_note: First-render timing starts in the capture SceneTree script and includes 30 settled frames; excludes engine process startup/import. Frame sample is 180 rendered frames after a 30-frame warmup, without ffmpeg capture running.
desktop-1280x720.memory_note: Godot allocator snapshot after captures and scene sampling. Allocator peak and process maximum RSS include screenshot allocations; these are not isolated production steady-state memory measurements.
desktop-1280x720.mobile_devices: None; these are desktop virtual-display captures, not Apple/Google device/store screenshots.
desktop-1280x720.source_snapshot_method: Recorded after final capture; observed source modification timestamps predate the final capture startup. This records the stable source files, not an independently logged hash of each script loaded inside that engine process.
desktop-1280x720.review_snapshot: Final compact-layout and paint-heading correction review snapshot; exported binaries have separate hashes.
